run_eval_overthink: run the eval_overthink function to verify student answers against ground truth using a verifier model
run_ensure_verifier_server: start a vLLM verifier server on a given port with a specified model path
run_call_verifier: call the verifier model via LiteLLM with retry logic to get a verification response
run_score_from_verifier: parse a verifier model response into a binary score of 0 or 1
run_postprocess_response: postprocess an LLM response by stripping tags, truncating, and extracting boxed content
